subject: Request: EuroEdge pilot - TIA scoping, UK Addendum path, and subprocessor inventory
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <legal@euroedge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: EuroEdge pilot - TIA scoping, UK Addendum path, and subprocessor inventory

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to line up the EuroEdge pilot. Legal flagged two items we wanted to escalate to you directly so we can avoid surprises during procurement:

1) International transfer scope (TIA/DTIA): EuroEdge's pilot will process EU customer data and one node may write logs to a UK fallback site. We need to confirm whether the standard SCCs + UK Addendum (UK IDTA) path is acceptable for the pilot, or whether you prefer a bespoke TIA mapping for the UK.

2) Subprocessor inventory & technical controls: can you confirm the level of subprocessor detail you require (company-level list vs. per-environment endpoints)? I've attached our current subprocessor inventory for the pilot and a simplified dataflow diagram.

Quick asks:
- Please confirm whether SCCs + UK Addendum are sufficient for your legal team, or if you need a separate DTIA mapping.
- Any mandatory contractual language or clauses EuroEdge insists on for pilot agreements (e.g., specific logging retention, HSM requirement, encryption key custody).

If helpful, I can loop in our contracts lead (Laura) to propose redlines to the standard DPA + UK Addendum we typically send for EU customers.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: subprocessor_inventory.csv (CSV stub), dataflow-diagram.png (image stub)

From: Sofia Alvarez <legal@euroedge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-18T12:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Request: EuroEdge pilot - TIA scoping, UK Addendum path, and subprocessor inventory

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the note and the attachments — helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- High level, SCCs + UK Addendum is our preferred route for vendor onboarding. We only ask for a separate DTIA mapping if a vendor cannot commit to the Addendum text or if there are multi-hop subprocessors in non-EU/UK jurisdictions.

- For the pilot, we need a per-subprocessor breakdown that includes: company name, country of processing, and whether they have access to plaintext or only encrypted artifacts. The CSV you shared is a good start but we need the country and access columns filled in.

- Concerning technical controls: EuroEdge requires proof of encryption at rest (AES-256 or equivalent), KMS/HSM usage for key management, and a 90-day retention default for logs unless otherwise negotiated.

Would you be able to provide the updated subprocessor CSV (with country/access columns) and a short note confirming KMS/HSM use by EOD Thursday (our local time)? If you can send proposed DPA redlines as well that will speed the review.

Regards,
Sofia Alvarez
Senior Counsel — Data Protection
EuroEdge

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-18T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: EuroEdge pilot - subprocessor details + DTIA question

Vanessa / Laura — forwarding Sofia's ask. I updated the subprocessor inventory to add 'country' and 'access' columns and flagged any subprocessors that may route logs through non-EEA locations. See attached CSV (subprocessor_inventory.csv).

Notes on technical controls:
- All hosted production workloads use our managed KMS (AWS KMS-backed HSM for root keys) and application-level envelope encryption.
- AES-256 at rest, TLS1.3 in transit.
- We retain request logs by default for 90 days; we can scope shorter retention for the pilot by route.

Laura — could you prepare redlines to the standard DPA + the UK Addendum? If possible, include a fallback DTIA mapping for the one subprocessor that has non-EEA logging destinations (this will cover the edge-case Sofia mentioned).

Thanks,
Kimberly

Attachment: subprocessor_inventory.csv (updated stub)

Laura / Jordan — forwarding the thread. Laura, can you prepare a clean redline doc for the DPA + UK Addendum that: 
- Explicitly references SCCs and includes the UK Addendum path as our primary transfer mechanism,

I'll draft the covering email to Sofia to attach the redlines and the DocuSign link.

-Vanessa

Thanks for the clarity on the DTIA triggers. Attached is the redline for our standard DPA with the UK Addendum included as the primary transfer mechanism; we've appended a narrow DTIA appendix that maps the one non-EEA logging subprocessor and the mitigations (log pseudonymization and transient storage).

- HSM-backed root key custody (AWS KMS with customer project separation) and AES-256 for data at rest.
- Default 90-day log retention, with per-route adjustment negotiated in the pilot SOW.

DocuSign link to start signature: https://docusign.com/link/abc123-euroedge-dpa
(Envelope contains: DPA_redline.pdf, UK_Addendum_exhibit.pdf, DTIA_appendix.pdf)
